ns2:section.sectionText: Drawing on the concepts and ideas that were presented in ENG 451, ENG 398 CVW will guide the student through an assessment of the company for which he/she is working via a course-long project that is broken into a series of assignments. In addition, the student will be required to complete a comprehensive assessment of the companyøs industry (including a competitive assessment of the key players in the industry) to identify an area where the company can improve and/or gain a competitive advantage. Based on the findings of the course project and assessment, the student will be asked to develop a business case and/or recommendations for how the company can create a competitive advantage based on the identified area.
